agentMessages.text: I’m using the storyfolio skill to build the approved storyboard. I’ll read the handover and content requirements, implement the site, and run the required checks and visual review.

The storyboard leaves the visual look open. Which direction would you like for the bench apparatus?
- Warm lab notebook: ivory, dark ink, copper and green
- Dark instrument bench: charcoal, pale labels and amber
- Choose the visual look for me

The scene will keep one recognizable bench apparatus through all five chapters. I’m separating the code-to-board check from the two evidence paths, so visitors can see why the two-year projection and the 72-hour run support different claims.

I’m proceeding with the warm lab-notebook look: ivory, dark ink, copper connections and a green board. Dependencies installed successfully from the supplied offline cache after the network install was blocked. The story now includes complete HTML explanations, attribution and evidence limits; I’m checking the apparatus on desktop and phone layouts next.

The first visual review shows the apparatus staying beside the desktop text, with the instruments and green board recognizable across chapters. I found a type error in the relationship extra and fixed it; typecheck and lint now pass. I’m reviewing the phone framing and scroll transitions as the production browser checks run.

The phone review shows the scene fitting above the complete explanation. I also found that the connectors disappeared before the evidence chapter; I’ve extended their visibility so both evidence paths remain inspectable. I’m sharpening the printed labels and moving chapter navigation away from the instruments before the final check.

The evidence chapter now visibly separates the projection and observed-run branches. Small face labels were being compressed by the starter’s card-shaped textures; I’ve corrected the lettering proportions for the board and instruments. The final production checks are running again with that correction.

The corrected labels are now readable. I spotted one remaining overlap between the lower instrument and the fixture inscription and moved the fixture down to clear it. Pointer and keyboard navigation checks have passed so far; the transition review covers both directions on desktop, phone and a 500px-high viewport.

The supplied `.git` directory is read-only and empty, so a normal commit is blocked. I’ll preserve the work with Git metadata in a writable local directory and document how to access it.

The control and transition review passed, including the short-height viewport. I also need to correct the check record: rebuilding while earlier browser runs were still active invalidated their asset paths. Those runs aren’t valid acceptance evidence. I’m letting them finish, then running one fresh, sequential production check against the final source.
